# MCP tools: Journal

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 9 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `list_journal_entries`

Use this for a bounded date-filtered list of at most 366 inclusive calendar days of the authenticated user's journal entries, oldest first.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `journal:read`.

Returns: `JournalEntryPageResult` with `entries` (array of JournalEntryRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null), `owner_timezone` (string), `today` (date).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `from_date` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `10`; 1 to 50 |
| `to_date` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |

## `get_journal_entry`

Use this for one known owned entry UUID, usually from a list result, when the user asks to see that entry.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `journal:read`.

Returns: `JournalEntryResult` with `entry` (JournalEntryRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entry_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `true` |

## `get_journal_day`

Use this for bounded entries and summary status on one explicit date.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `journal:read`.

Returns: `JournalDayResult` with `done` (DayDoneRecord), `entries` (array of JournalEntryRecord), `entry_fingerprint` (string), `journal_date` (date), `next_cursor` (string or null), `owner_timezone` (string), `summary` (JournalSummaryRecord), `today` (date).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `journal_date` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `10`; 1 to 50 |

## `get_journal_source`

Use this for one known owned source UUID to read its immutable provenance: type, dates, language, replacement link, and fingerprint.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `journal:read`.

Returns: `JournalSourceReadResult` with `source` (JournalSourceReadRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `true` |

## `list_pending_journal`

Use this for a bounded list of preserved sources on one explicit date range that still await manual or AI-assisted review, with draft state and no source text.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `journal:read`.

Returns: `PendingJournalPageResult` with `items` (array of PendingJournalItemRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from_date` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `100`; 1 to 100 |
| `to_date` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |

## `write_journal_entry`

Use this when the user asks to write or save a journal entry (e.g. "skriv dagbok").

Access: write

Scopes: requires `journal:write`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:read`, `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `JournalEntryResult` with `entry` (JournalEntryRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `journal_date` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `source_text` | string | yes | 1 to 100000 characters |
| `title` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `contact_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |
| `key_points` | array of object | no | up to 50 items; may be null |
| `key_points[].kind` | string | yes | one of `fact`, `reflection`, `decision`, `commitment`, `question` |
| `key_points[].text` | string | yes | 1 to 2000 characters |
| `language` | string | no | 2 to 35 characters; may be null |
| `occurred_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `project_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |
| `summary` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |
| `task_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `update_journal_entry`

Use this to add to, correct or relink an existing journal entry (e.g. 'lägg till i dagens dagbok'); read it first and send its current version.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `journal:read`, `journal:write`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:read`, `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `JournalEntryResult` with `entry` (JournalEntryRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entry_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `expected_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `add_contact_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |
| `add_project_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |
| `append_key_points` | array of object | no | up to 50 items; may be null |
| `append_key_points[].kind` | string | yes | one of `fact`, `reflection`, `decision`, `commitment`, `question` |
| `append_key_points[].text` | string | yes | 1 to 2000 characters |
| `append_text` | string | no | 1 to 100000 characters; may be null |
| `key_points` | array of object | no | up to 50 items; may be null |
| `key_points[].kind` | string | yes | one of `fact`, `reflection`, `decision`, `commitment`, `question` |
| `key_points[].text` | string | yes | 1 to 2000 characters |
| `remove_contact_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |
| `remove_project_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 25 items; unique; may be null |
| `summary` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |
| `title` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `set_daily_journal_summary`

Use this when the user asks you to write or replace the daily journal summary for one explicit date.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `journal:write`.

Returns: `JournalSummaryResult` with `summary` (JournalSummaryRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expected_entry_fingerprint` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `journal_date` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `summary_text` | string | yes | 1 to 20000 characters |
| `expected_summary_version` | integer | no | at least 1; may be null |

## `get_journal_draft`

Use this only when the user wants to review one known owned AI-derived journal draft UUID.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `journal:read`.

Returns: `JournalDraftReadResult` with `draft` (JournalDraftRecord), `source` (JournalSourceReadRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `draft_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `true` |
